dataset: eta — radiative-efficiency weight on claimed land, per collective
_source: ERA5 reanalysis single levels (0.25 deg), synoptic archive 00/06/12/18 UTC, 1st of Jan/Mar/May/Aug/Oct/Dec, every 5th year 1940-2025. Boundaries: Natural Earth 10m admin-0. Generated 2026-08-05.

_method.daily_mean: mean of the four synoptic hours; only days with all four are used (107 of 108 balanced days). Diurnal aliasing measured at <0.53 W/m2 worst zonal bias, <0.2% of mean OLR, stable 1940-2020.
_method.field: OLR = -avg_tnlwrfcs (clear-sky) / -avg_tnlwrf (all-sky); ECMWF net radiation is positive-downward. Reanalysis grid only (Ni=1440) — the 0.5 deg ensemble shares shortNames and must be excluded.
_method.weighting: cos(latitude) x land FRACTION (lsm), not a binary threshold, so partial coastal cells contribute their actual land area.
_method.aggregation: land-area-weighted mean of eta over cells whose centre falls in the collective; sub-grid collectives inherit a neighbourhood mean (see method field) at the smallest radius containing land.

_basis.shipped_default: clear_sky (data.ETA_BASIS). All-sky credits a collective for being cloudy — cloud is not a policy lever, is partly endogenous to warming, and is the noisiest part of the field. Clear-sky measures the structural transparency of the column.
_basis.all_sky_retained: Reported alongside as the physical reality check. The GAP is the diagnostic: where it is large the basis choice is doing real work. Singapore +0.129 (persistently convective — all-sky would penalise it for cloud it does not control), Brazil +0.066, Gulf states -0.05..-0.08.

_normalisation.basis: CLAIMED land, Antarctica EXCLUDED, so the mean is 1 on the same footing as A_LAND_CLAIMED_M2 (1.35e14 m2), the denominator of psi*.
_normalisation.why: Normalising over all land instead inflates every other collective by 2.96%, because Antarctica is 8.35% of cos-weighted land at eta ~0.67. eta REDISTRIBUTES a fixed budget — sum(eta_i * a_i) = sum(a_i) — so a mismatched denominator would silently change the total allocated.

_limitations.seasonal: 6 months per year and unevenly spaced (+2,+2,+3,+2,+2 — not strictly bimonthly). This is a sampled climatology, not an annual mean.
_limitations.day_of_month: the 1st only; 107 days total. Per-cell values carry weather noise that partly averages out in collective aggregates but not entirely.
_limitations.1940: two synoptic slots missing, costing one month of that year.
_limitations.conceptual: eta is TOTAL outgoing longwave, so hot arid land scores high. Whether high OLR means spare capacity or an already-stressed surface is a live question; a marginal-capacity measure would be a different rule. See the review.

_marginal_capacity_investigated.question: eta as shipped is TOTAL outgoing longwave, so hot arid land scores high. Whether that means spare capacity or an already-stressed surface is a live question; the conceptually apter measure is MARGINAL capacity dOLR/dT_surface — how much extra the column sheds per unit of additional warming.
_marginal_capacity_investigated.result: NEGATIVE — not determinable from this sampling. Three estimators were built and they disagree materially.

estimators.seasonal (across the 6 sampled months): 35.2% of land weight at r2<0.5; the tropics have only ~5 K of seasonal range to regress against, and the inversion it produces is concentrated in exactly those unreliable cells. Raw spread p05-p95 7.6x vs 1.5x for total OLR — mostly noise.
estimators.diurnal (within-day, across the 4 synopt: BEST conditioned, 5.8% at r2<0.5, mean diurnal range 13.3 K. But it measures the FAST response, with the atmospheric column effectively fixed — the wrong timescale for a sustained heat addition.
estimators.interannual (within-month, across the 18: the RIGHT timescale — the equilibrated response a permanent addition acts on — but the WORST conditioned, 57.6% at r2<0.5 (UAE 0.02, Singapore 0.08). Unusable.

_marginal_capacity_investigated.disagreement: Brazil spans 0.802 (diurnal) to 1.612 (interannual); UAE 0.273 to 0.977. The estimators do not measure the same physical quantity, and the best-conditioned one answers the wrong question.
_marginal_capacity_investigated.physical_check: mean dOLR/dT = 1.4-1.9 W/m2/K against a graybody 4*sigma*T^3 of 5.4 — the water-vapour effect made visible, and a sign the regressions are capturing real physics even where they are noisy.
_marginal_capacity_investigated.resolves_by: 12-month sampling with more days per month, giving enough seasonal AND interannual temperature variation to condition the regression at the sustained-forcing timescale. This is a DATA requirement, not an analysis one — no rearrangement of the present archive fixes it.
_marginal_capacity_investigated.status: eta ships on TOTAL clear-sky OLR. The conceptual objection stands and is NOT resolved; it is recorded so the next attempt starts from the negative result rather than repeating it.
